ICS 97.220.40MED 6Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This Code (Part 3) is applicable to water slides of 2 m and more as defined in IS 15492 (Part 2).1.2 This Code establishes the instructions for use, operation, and maintenance, as well as the documentation and commissioning of water, slide over 2 m in height.1.3 Nothing in this Code is intended to contravene the provision of any of the existing Government regulation(s). It is the responsibility of the user of this Code to establish appropriate safety and health practices and comply with regulatory and statutory requirements prior to using the water park, pools.
